_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 3% of 12h windows producing ±2+ point moves, this is a textbook coil where the statistically honest call is HOLD until either ETF flows recover above 30 (upside breaker) or VIX breaks 70 with BTC losing $60K (downside breaker).
next_move.brains_agree: No — the narrative implies an imminent UP reversal toward Hope/Optimism while the analyst explicitly calls HOLD; the consensus sides with the analyst's coil-aware base rate and higher trust weight, treating the narrative's bottoming thesis as a setup-in-waiting rather than an actionable trigger.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND funding stays below 55 AND BTC holds $62K — this would validate the bottoming narrative and shift phase toward Hope (up one rung).
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay near 0 AND VIX breaks above 70 AND BTC loses $60K — this would break the coil downward toward Complacency or lower, invalidating the accumulation thesis.
